# Qanary

> Qanary is a free, open-source Python package for running parameter sweeps
> and recording measurements with QCoDeS instruments. Measurements are stored
> as xarray datasets with metadata and can be plotted live in Qimchi.

Qanary is developed by SQUAD Lab at Forschungszentrum Jülich (PGI-11) and is
licensed under the AGPL-3.0-or-later. It requires Python 3.13 and is installed
from PyPI (`uv add qanary`).

## Authors

In citation order, as in Qanary's CITATION.cff:

- [Spandan Anupam](https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4996-3265): Forschungszentrum Jülich, ORCID 0000-0003-4996-3265
- [Simon Schreibing](https://orcid.org/0009-0008-9815-2876): Forschungszentrum Jülich, ORCID 0009-0008-9815-2876
- [Jyotirmaya Shivottam](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2688-9421): Forschungszentrum Jülich, ORCID 0000-0002-2688-9421
- [Vincent Mourik](https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1522-7403): Forschungszentrum Jülich, ORCID 0000-0003-1522-7403

## Project

- [Source code](https://gitlab.com/squad-lab/qanary): Repository, examples and issue tracker
- [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/qanary/): Released packages
- [CITATION.cff](https://gitlab.com/squad-lab/qanary/-/blob/main/CITATION.cff): How to cite Qanary
- [Zenodo DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23536660): Archived releases and version DOIs

## Related

- [Qimchi](https://qimchi.squad-lab.org/): Plotting and analysis software for the measurements Qanary records, including live plotting
- [Qimchi-Connect](https://gitlab.com/squad-lab/qimchi-connect): The library Qanary uses to publish running measurements to Qimchi
- [QCoDeS](https://microsoft.github.io/Qcodes/): The instrument framework Qanary builds on
- [xarray](https://docs.xarray.dev/): The data model of Qanary's datasets
